title: Nonhuman progression: every skill cell, XP carriers, legitimate gains and elapsed parity
head: b6678ea9ba4a7cf0313ce83e0c0fc6b0e5c26d5b

reviews.classification: Full progression palette; applicable execution, carrier, rate and continuity boundaries retained
reviews.disposition:
F1. Full content review covers PS1–PS10, every one of the 64 skill rows and fifteen applicability cells per row, PM1–PM12, all fifteen stat/growth/idle profiles, PF1–PF7, fourteen succession rows, PG1–PG15 and PSG1–PSG5. The 960-cell matrix is a proposed applicability map over a historically inspected catalogue, not 960 working consumers, tests, free starting masteries or a current skill-count census. D/M/R/H/C/V keep ordinary method, mapped method, replacement, actual helper and conditional/current-form policy distinct. A familiar is a relationship rather than a winged anatomy; undead/monster labels do not set one material or faculty template.

F2. Retained knowledge, actual executor practice, source/tissue adaptation and granted faculty have distinct carriers. Classify mixed legacy XP where a real consumer needs it, preserving original amount/provenance instead of cloning it into independently spendable tracks or deleting dormant earned work. A host/wielder/repair worker's practice is not automatically the guide/object/controller's; explicit real sharing can still grant its declared effects. Perfect remapping and strong innate control work when actually provided. Historical Unarmed and sword coefficients with different bases are not a damage ratio; cosmetic race settings, default fists/oxygen or truthy zero fallbacks do not define physical truth for every body.

F3. Compare useful task output, means and next actionable capability, rather than forcing equal levels or one cross-world power scalar. Structural stage, source, mastery, quality, condition and institutional clearance remain separate. A superior hound nose, construct actuator, brood throughput or source immunity can remain superior under AD22/AD38. Species resemblance does not mandate weakness, adaptation grind, human end form, a countervulnerability or equal-reward cap. The proposed no-endless-progression/no-heal-farming statements do not prohibit real repeated growth, healing, regeneration or renewable organs through actual mechanisms; prevent duplicate output/state settlement, not legitimate source advantages.

F4. Positive eligible fractional progress needs a retained remainder and declared batch semantics. One giant capped XP call and many small rounded calls may differ; milestone crossings, parent forwarding, age/furniture/pacing factors and rest-speed clocks need a selected-consumer parity check. Idle ticking, accelerated rest, reviewed elapsed packing and actual absent-world continuation are different operations. The old finite packing constants and browser-freeze sentence are attributed historical scope, not current global balance or universal scheduler proof. A funded routine can retain actual supported online/elapsed results without an invented offline penalty or duplicate interval payout. Member count changes actual parallel work, not automatically shared XP for every member.

F5. Growth, repair, maturation and same-person embodiment changes are not automatically prestige. Independent heirs and continuing minds need different knowledge/body/source/estate/obligation handling. The narrow half-standing heir policy does not define universal succession; the expansion-replacement hazard must be checked at the actual builder before claiming a selected body survives. Reforging cannot silently duplicate an item or erase identity, while actual source rules can genuinely end continuity. The one-realm/one-prestige milestone and 1366-primary presentation sentence are superseded, including their repetition in succession and PSG5. Apply current campaign order, desktop context, AD36/AD43 proof stages and AD42 optional human review. Under AD32 the proposed schema, rate bands, migration and five suggestions remain proposals; this read renews no linked code, book, numeric balance, browser or persistence proof.
reviews.evidence: Entire 302-line input delivered in ranges 1–125,126–235,236–302. Historical source locators and sibling lore are attributed rather than freshly authenticated.
reviews.reopen: Actual progression/XP/elapsed or heir consumer changes; select relevant mechanisms and parity/persistence scenario without requiring all64 new tracks or all bodies.
